# Zenvi tools

<!-- Generated by packages/engine/scripts/gen-tools-doc.ts from @zenvi/engine/tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

One tool catalog for every Zenvi surface: the Zenvi Assistant in the web editor, the local MCP server (`zenvi mcp`), the Zenvi Cloud remote MCP server, and the CLI. 85 tools: 73 of the 169 tools Zenvi desktop lists (zenvi-core develop `1f80cb3d061b`; same names, arguments and receipts) and 12 direct tools for coding agents. The other desktop tools are not ported yet (see [Not ported yet](#not-ported-yet)).

Every call returns a contract-3 receipt (`{contract: 3, status, tool, summary, clips, …, undoSteps}`); a failure's summary starts with `Error:`, and a surface limitation says `Error: <tool> is not available in this Zenvi surface: …` (do not retry). One call is at most one undo step.

## Where tools work

| Surface | Host | Works | Partial | Not available |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Web editor (Zenvi Assistant, command palette) | `apps/editor/src/features/editor/assistant/host.ts` | 59 | 12 | 14 |
| CLI and local MCP server (zenvi, zenvi mcp) | `packages/render-node/src/host/node-host.ts` | 56 | 12 | 17 |
| Zenvi Cloud remote MCP server (ChatGPT, Claude.ai) | `packages/cloud/src/mcp/engine.ts` | 52 | 12 | 21 |
| Zenvi desktop | zenvi-core | 73 | 0 | 12 (direct tools are web-only) |

Availability follows each tool's required host capabilities and the host methods it calls at run time; the hosts are described in `SURFACE_PROFILES` (packages/engine/src/tools/availability.ts). Capabilities a session may lack (signed out of Zenvi, no WebCodecs export) are noted per tool.

- **Web editor (Zenvi Assistant, command palette)**: media, player, ui, exporter, frames, backend, storage; methods media.importUrl, media.pickFiles, media.writeGenerated, ui.openExportDialog; only sometimes: exporter (browsers with WebCodecs export), backend (signed in to Zenvi).
- **CLI and local MCP server (zenvi, zenvi mcp)**: media, exporter, frames, audio, storage, backend; methods media.importPath, media.listPaths, media.importUrl, media.writeGenerated, storage.open, storage.readText, storage.writeText; only sometimes: backend (signed in with zenvi login).
- **Zenvi Cloud remote MCP server (ChatGPT, Claude.ai)**: media, frames, storage, assets, audio, backend; methods media.importUrl, media.writeGenerated, storage.readText, storage.writeText; only sometimes: frames (the render worker is configured), media (ffprobe is available), assets (title templates are bundled), audio (ffmpeg is available), backend (the server is set up to call the Zenvi backend); hides 13 local-app tools.

## Tools

### get_project_info_tool

**Read project info**. Return project profile, fps, duration, and scale.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

No arguments.

### list_files_tool

**List project media**. List media-bin files (paths, ids) — not timeline positions.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

No arguments.

### list_clips_tool

**List clips**. List timeline clips with source_start/end, summary_preview, and occurrence_hint when duplicates exist.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `layer` | string |  | Optional layer_number or UI track filter. |
| `detail_level` | string |  | summary (default) or full — accepted for Assistant/LLM compat; listing is always complete. |

### list_layers_tool

**List tracks**. List tracks/layers (ui_track and layer_number).

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

No arguments.

### list_markers_tool

**List markers**. List every marker in the project.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

No arguments.

### new_project_tool

**New project**. Create a new empty project.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive.

Availability: editor partial (only Zenvi desktop takes profile so far); cli partial (only Zenvi desktop takes profile so far); cloud — (hidden: belongs to a local app); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `discard_unsaved` | boolean |  | Throw away unsaved changes in the current project. Only after the user agreed. (default false) |
| `profile` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Optional video profile or social preset for the new project, e.g. 'instagram_reel', 'youtube_4k', 'FHD 1080p 30 fps' (see list_project_profiles_tool). Empty = default profile. (default "") |
| `save_first` | boolean |  | Save the current project to its existing file first (it must have been saved before). (default false) |

### save_project_tool

**Save project**. Save the project to file_path (e.g.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive. Needs: storage.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud — (hidden: belongs to a local app); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file_path` | string |  | Where to save. Empty = the project's current file (Save). A new path = Save As (.zvn is added when there is no project extension; missing folders are created). (default "") |
| `overwrite` | boolean |  | Allow replacing an existing file that is not this project's current file. (default false) |
| `path` | string |  | Where to save the project (.zvn is appended when missing). Omit to save to the current location. |

### open_project_tool

**Open project**. Open a project from file_path.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive. Needs: storage.

Availability: editor — (needs opening project files); cli partial (only Zenvi desktop takes recent_index so far); cloud — (hidden: belongs to a local app); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `discard_unsaved` | boolean |  | Throw away unsaved changes in the current project. Only after the user agreed. (default false) |
| `file_path` | string |  | Path of a .zvn project (legacy .osp/.flow also open). Leave empty when using recent_index. (default "") |
| `recent_index` | integer |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Open a recent project instead: 1 = most recent (see list_recent_projects_tool). 0 = use file_path. (default 0, min 0, max 10) |
| `save_first` | boolean |  | Save the current project to its existing file before opening the other one. (default false) |

### watch_clip_tool

**Load and play clip**. Play a clip in the editor preview: seek to a timeline clip (timeline_clip_id or query) and start playback.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits. Needs: player.

Availability: editor partial (file_path needs local file access); cli — (needs playback); cloud — (hidden: belongs to a local app); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file_path` | string |  | Media path to import, place and play. |
| `query` | string |  | Describe the timeline clip to play. |
| `file_id` | string |  | Media-bin file to play (added to the timeline when it is not there yet). |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip to play. |

### watch_clip_window_tool

**Watch clip window**. Vision-check whether a query is actually visible in a window of a placed clip.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only, open world. Needs: frames, backend.

Availability: editor yes (only when signed in to Zenvi); cli yes (only when signed in with zenvi login); cloud yes (only when the render worker is configured and the server is set up to call the Zenvi backend); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | string |  | What should be on screen in the window. |
| `start` | string \| number |  | Window start, source seconds (12, 12.5 or 0:12). Give start and end together, or neither to watch the best search match. |
| `end` | string \| number |  | Window end, source seconds. |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip id (from list_clips_tool, get_timeline_state_tool or an earlier receipt). |
| `clip_query` | string |  | Describe the clip instead of passing an id: file name, subject, or words from its summary. Narrow it with track, occurrence or position_near. |
| `track` | string |  | Track: layer_number (preferred), track_id, the exact label, or ui_track counted from the bottom (1 = bottom). |
| `occurrence` | string \| number |  | 1-based pick when the query matches the same source several times (0 = best match). |
| `position_near` | string \| number \| null |  | Timeline seconds; only clips that span this time match. |

### play_tool

**Play / pause**. Control preview playback: action play, pause, toggle (default, like the Space bar), stop (pause and return to the start), or step_forward / step_back by frames.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. read-only. Needs: player.

Availability: editor yes; cli — (needs playback); cloud — (hidden: belongs to a local app); desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | "toggle" \| "play" \| "pause" \| "stop" \| "fast_forward" \| "rewind" \| "step_forward" \| "step_back" |  | What to do. play / pause (always pass one of these for a plain 'play' or 'pause'); toggle = the Space bar; stop = pause and return to the start; fast_forward / rewind = the L / J keys (one speed step faster forward / backward); step_forward / step_back = pause and move by `frames`. (default "toggle") |
| `frames` | integer |  | For step_forward / step_back: how many frames to move. (default 1, min 1, max 10000) |
| `speed` | integer \| null |  | For action='play': playback speed, 1 = normal, 2 or 4 = fast, -1 = backwards. Omit for normal speed. (min -16, max 16) |

### undo_tool

**Undo**. Undo the last action, or the last N actions.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | string \| number |  | Number of undo steps. (default 1) |

### redo_tool

**Redo**. Redo the last undone action, or the last N undone actions.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | string \| number |  | Number of redo steps (1-20). (default 1) |

### add_track_tool

**Add track**. Add empty tracks: on top (default, like the Add Track button), at the bottom, or above / below the track in relative_to.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | integer |  | How many tracks to add in this one step. With a name they are called '<name> 1' .. '<name> N' from bottom to top. (default 1, min 1, max 10) |
| `name` | string |  | Name shown in the new track's header, e.g. 'Music'. Empty = the default 'Track N'. (default "") |
| `position` | "top" \| "bottom" \| "above" \| "below" |  | Where the new track goes: 'top' (above every track, like the Add Track button), 'bottom' (below every track), or 'above' / 'below' the track in relative_to (Track menu > Add Track Above / Below). (default "top") |
| `relative_to` | string |  | For position 'above' / 'below': the existing track, as a UI track number (1 = bottom), track name, track id (L3) or layer number. (default "") |
| `label` | string |  | Alias for name. |

### add_marker_tool

**Add marker**. Add a timeline marker at position_seconds (default: the playhead), with a name and a colour tag.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | "blue" \| "red" \| "green" \| "yellow" \| "orange" \| "purple" \| "pink" \| "white" |  | Marker color tag; the timeline tints the marker's icon with it (blue = the default icon) and shows the marker's name next to it. (default "blue") |
| `name` | string |  | Marker name, e.g. 'Drop', 'Chorus', 'Cut here'. Used to find it again. (default "") |
| `position_seconds` | number \| null |  | Timeline seconds for the marker (0:32 = 32, 1:05 = 65). Omit to mark the playhead position. (min 0) |
| `label` | string |  | Alias for name. |
| `text` | string |  | Alias for name. |

### delete_from_timeline_tool

**Delete from timeline**. Delete from the timeline: one clip placement, or an entire track.

Surfaces: assistant, mcp, cli, editor. edits, destructive.

Availability: editor yes; cli yes; cloud yes; desktop yes.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip id (from list_clips_tool, get_timeline_state_tool or an earlier receipt). |
| `clip_query` | string |  | Describe the clip instead of passing an id: file name, subject, or words from its summary. Narrow it with track, occurrence or position_near. |
| `track` | string |  | Track: layer_number (preferred), track_id, the exact label, or ui_track counted from the bottom (1 = bottom). |
| `scope` | "auto" \| "clip" \| "track" |  | auto (default): a clip id/query deletes one placement, a bare track clears the track. clip / track force the branch. (default "auto") |
| `occurrence` | string |  | 1-based pick when the query matches the same source several times (0 = best match). (default "0") |
| `position_near` | string \| number \| null |  | Timeline seconds; only clips that span this time match. |
| `include_transitions` | boolean |  | Track scope only: also delete transitions on the track (default true). (default true) |
| `ripple` | string \| boolean |  | One clip only: true closes the gap it leaves (later items on that track move left); default false leaves the gap. (default false) |

| `properties` | object |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Effect properties to set, as {name: value}. A value is a number, true/false, a choice name ("HSV/HSL hue"), a color ("#00ff00") or text; or keyframes [{"time": 2.0, "value": 10, "interpolation": "linear"}] in timeline seconds to animate it. list_effects_tool(effect=...) lists every property with its range, default and choices. |
| `scope` | "" \| "selected" \| "track" \| "all" |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Instead of ids/query: 'selected' = timeline selection, 'track' = every clip on `track`, 'all' = every clip. Clips that cannot take the effect (locked track, no picture/sound) are skipped and listed. (default "") |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip id from list_clips_tool / get_timeline_state_tool. Preferred. (default "") |

| `font_weight` | "" \| "bold" \| "normal" |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Make the text bold or normal weight; empty keeps the template's. (default "") |
| `lines` | string[] |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Every field in order (as listed by list_title_templates_tool), for templates with several lines such as Standard_4 or credits. Overrides text/subtitle; fields left out are blanked. |

| `screen_position` | "auto" \| "top" \| "center" \| "bottom" |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Where the 16:9 title artboard sits when the project is not 16:9 (vertical reels, square): auto = by where the template's text is (lower thirds at the bottom, headers at the top). On 9:16 video bottom/top titles are lifted clear of the platform UI bands. (default "auto") |
| `subtitle` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Text for the template's subtitle field (second line), e.g. a role under a name. (default "") |

| `track` | string |  | UI track number (1 = bottom), name or layer for the title. Empty = the lowest free track above every clip with video at that time (a new top track when none is free). (default "") |

| `clip_query` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Describe the clip to caption instead of an id, e.g. 'talking head'. (default "") |
| `cues` | object[] |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Captions to show, each {start, end, text} in timeline seconds (or the clip's source seconds with time_base='source'). Use for text you already have. |
| `engine` | string |  | Accepted for compatibility; not used (the transcript comes from the media index). (default "auto") |
| `fade_seconds` | number |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Fade each caption in and out over this many seconds (0-3). -1 = the style's. (default -1, min -1, max 3) |
| `font` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Font family, e.g. 'Arial Black', 'Helvetica Neue'. Empty = the style's font. (default "") |
| `language` | string |  | Accepted for compatibility with the on-device speech tools; the transcript comes from Zenvi's media index, which already knows the language. (default "auto") |
| `maxChars` | integer |  | Longest caption, in characters, when phrasing a transcript. (default 42, min 8, max 120) |
| `maxWords` | integer |  | Longest caption, in words, when phrasing a transcript (subtitle files and cues are kept as written). (default 8, min 1, max 24) |
| `modelId` | string |  | Accepted for compatibility; not used (the transcript comes from the media index). (default "") |
| `overlay_track` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Track for the transparent 'Captions' overlay clip used when no clip is captioned. Empty = the lowest free track above the video. (default "") |
| `position` | "" \| "bottom" \| "center" \| "top" |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Where the captions sit: bottom (above the safe margin, higher on vertical video), center or top. Empty = the style's (bottom). (default "") |
| `replace_existing` | boolean |  | Replace the captions a clip already has (true) or add a second caption track to it (false). (default true) |
| `srtPath` | string |  | Path of an .srt or .vtt subtitle file to burn in. With a clip its times are that clip's media time; without one, timeline time. (default "") |
| `stroke_color` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Outline colour. Empty = the style's. (default "") |
| `stroke_width` | number |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Outline thickness relative to the text height: 0 = none, 0.03 thin, 0.09 heavy (heavy outlines only read with heavy fonts such as Arial Black). -1 = the style's. (default -1, min -1, max 0.5) |
| `style` | "boxed" \| "classic" \| "minimal" \| "reels" \| "yellow" |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Look preset: classic = white text on a dark box at the bottom (subtitles); reels = big bold white text with a black outline (Instagram/TikTok/Shorts); minimal = small white text with a thin outline; yellow = yellow text with a black outline (TV subtitles); boxed = white on a solid black box. The arguments below override parts of it. (default "classic") |
| `text_color` | string |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Text colour '#RRGGBB' / '#RRGGBBAA' / 'rgba(...)' / name. Empty = the style's. (default "") |
| `text_size` | number |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Text height as a fraction of the frame's shorter side: 0.04 small, 0.05 normal subtitles, 0.075 big reel captions. 0 = the style's size. (default 0, min 0, max 0.3) |
| `time_base` | "auto" \| "timeline" \| "source" |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** What cue times mean: timeline seconds, or the clip's source (media) seconds. auto = source for subtitle files and transcripts, timeline for cues. (default "auto") |
| `timeline_clip_id` | string |  | Timeline clip to caption. (default "") |
| `trackIndex` | integer |  | Caption every clip on this UI track (1 = bottom) from its transcript. 0 = not used. (default 0, min 0) |
| `uppercase` | boolean |  | **Zenvi desktop only so far.** Show the captions in capital letters. (default false) |

- **ai-generation (editor_tools)** (6): `cancel_comfyui_job_tool`, `create_media_with_comfyui_tool`, `enhance_file_with_comfyui_tool`, `list_comfyui_jobs_tool`, `list_comfyui_templates_tool`, `prepare_recording_tool`

## Divergences from the desktop

Deliberate differences from the zenvi-core handlers:

- **add_title_tool**: The text also replaces every line whose placeholder matches the first line's. Reflection templates (Bar_1, the default) draw a mirrored copy first; the desktop's `_set_svg_text` (agent_tools/titles.py:32) fills only that copy and blanks the real line, so its titles render upside down.
- **add_clip_to_timeline_tool**: Appending (no position_seconds) butts the clip against the last clip on the track. The desktop places it at `last_end + _one_frame` (tool_handlers.py:2726), leaving a one-frame black/silent gap.
- **add_clip_to_timeline_tool and the tools that place through it**: A host that cannot watch frames (no frame rendering or no Zenvi backend) counts as "not watched": a duration-only trim of a full video is refused instead of placing the first N seconds, and the result never says "(watched)". The desktop's watch falls back softly and places the window.
- **watch (add_clip_to_timeline_tool, slice_clip_at_best_match_tool, search_clip_scenes_tool, watch_clip_window_tool)**: Up to 12 frames rendered by the host; no ffmpeg scene-cut detection (shot cuts are always reported as none) and no near-duplicate frame dedupe (watch_window.py extract_watch_window).
- **apply_transition_tool**: clip2 defaults to the next clip on clip1's track instead of `Error: clip2_id is required` (tool_handlers.py:6645); no transition_name means fade (the desktop took the first file in its transitions folder).
- **reindex_project_file_tool**: "Already indexed" reads the current `ai_metadata.index` block (legacy `twelvelabs` as fallback); the desktop reads only `twelvelabs` (tool_handlers.py:7344). Re-uploading for indexing is not available on the web.
- **add_marker_tool / list_markers_tool**: A marker's name is stored as `label`, the key the web editor shows; zenvi-core develop stores `name` (track_ops.add_marker). list_markers_tool reads either.
- **add_title_tool / add_captions_tool**: Templates are the bundled catalog, read by basename only (the desktop joined a bare template name into its titles folder unchecked, agent_tools/titles.py:81); an absolute .svg path is read through the host's storage.
- **get_transcript_tool, export_captions_tool, add_captions_tool**: Transcripts come from the indexed `ai_metadata.transcript_cues`; word timings inside a cue are estimated by character count (`transcriptionSource: "index_cues"`, `wordTiming: "estimated"`). The desktop runs on-device ASR.
- **remove_silence_tool**: Speech windows come from the desktop's energy VAD run on the host's RMS envelope (AudioHost.analyzeAudio), not from on-device VAD models.
- **web-only arguments**: Hosts without a playhead or local file paths, and the CLI, need a few arguments the desktop's schemas do not have (scripts/tool-schema-overlay.json `web_extra_props`): add_marker_tool label/text and add_track_tool label (older names for `name`), save_project_tool path, set_clip_volume_tool volume/gain/db, watch_clip_tool file_id/timeline_clip_id, import_stock_media_tool position_seconds/track/duration_seconds/start_seconds (place the import). Every argument the desktop accepts is accepted; the ones only the desktop handles so far are refused (see Not ported yet).
- **desktop defaults the web does not follow yet**: save_project_tool and export_video_tool replace an existing file (the CLI's) where the desktop refuses unless overwrite=true; add_title_tool never shrinks long lines (desktop fit_text=true); add_captions_tool adds a new caption group where the desktop replaces the clip's captions (replace_existing=true); new_project_tool / open_project_tool have no unsaved-changes guard (every web surface autosaves, so discard_unsaved is accepted as is); generate_tts_and_add_to_timeline_tool defaults to the track below the picture, where the desktop picks or creates a free narration track.
- **tools zenvi-core develop rewrote as editor tools**: get_project_info_tool, list_markers_tool, get_export_settings_tool, set_export_setting_tool, new/open/save_project_tool, play_tool, add_track_tool, add_marker_tool, export_video_tool, generate_tts_and_add_to_timeline_tool, add_effect_tool, add_title_tool, set_keyframes_tool, set_project_setting_tool and add_captions_tool take develop's schemas; their results keep the earlier text and receipts (develop answers with structured receipts), set_export_setting_tool stores any key (develop checks keys and aliases), and set_keyframes_tool animates the seven earlier properties (develop: any keyframable clip property).
- **split_file_add_clip_tool**: require_visual_match reads true/false; the desktop's `bool(...)` treats the string "false" as true (tool_handlers.py:2370).
- **wait_for_editor_job_tool (desktop MCP extra, #237)**: Pending, and likely to stay so: tool calls here run to completion inside the call, so there is never a detached editor job; the name gets the standard not-available refusal.
- **argument coercion**: As zenvi-core normalize_args, plus numbers/booleans become strings for string-only properties (MCP clients send typed JSON).
- **summary previews**: `…` is written as U+2026; the desktop's file had the mojibake `ΓÇª` (ai_metadata_utils.build_summary_preview).
